checks.name: architecture.cumulative_item_mapping
checks.message: Cumulative mastery assessments are linked to multiple competencies at the assignment-template level, not per question. The current auto-grader therefore records the same overall cumulative percentage as evidence for every competency linked to that mastery assessment. Weekly evidence still provides competency-specific checks, but item-level competency tagging would make quarterly/year-end mastery evidence more precise.
